column3: The dedicated slice selects its fixed x86-64 ABI in topic 0001, while topic 0002 enables i386 tasks, complete syscall dispatch, and syscall-user-dispatch.
Topic 0001 builds the x86-64 adapter, while topic 0002 adds i386 task support and both generated syscall tables.
Topic 0001 owns the fixed x86-64 ELF identity, while topic 0002 adds the ELF32 task mode without admitting arm64 userspace.
Topic 0001 defines the fixed x86 register bridge, while topic 0002 selects the ABI-correct restart syscall number for i386 and x86-64 tasks.
Topic 0001 declares x86-64 syscall translation, while topic 0002 adds i386 audit identity, generated dispatch tables, and the syscall-user-dispatch sigreturn hook.
Topic 0001 defines the x86-64 ptrace layout, while topic 0002 adds the matching i386 register layout.
Topic 0001 implements x86-64 mapping flags, while topic 0002 constrains compat mappings to the i386 address ceiling.

Topic 0001 exposes x86-64 regsets, topic 0002 adds the i386 general-register view, and topic 0004 replaces inherited arm64 ptrace layouts with x86 ones. Topic 0005 recognizes a stepped POPF or IRET, which writes TF itself.
Topic 0001 defines x86 register and int80 state, while topic 0002 adds the persistent compat-task bridge marker.
Topic 0001 implements the x86-64 signal ABI, topic 0002 adds i386 frames, floating-point state, and signal-return paths, and topic 0004 shares the XSAVE conversion with ptrace.
Topic 0001 owns x86-64 TLS state, while topic 0002 applies the i386 task-mode defaults needed by set_thread_area.
Topic 0001 implements x86-64 syscall translation, while topic 0002 replaces its provisional number map with generated dispatch and retains ABI-specific adapters.
Topic 0002 adapts generic ptrace to compat tasks, while topic 0004 routes x86-64 PTRACE_GETREGS and SETREGS to the slice's x86 layouts.
Topic 0001 dispatches the fixed x86-64 ABI, while topic 0002 separates true i386 int80 calls and applies syscall-user-dispatch before both complete generated tables.
Topic 0001 transports fixed x86 task state, while topic 0002 publishes the persistent compat decoding mode to the host bridge. Topic 0005 steps x86 tasks with RFLAGS.TF and reports #DB as TRAP_TRACE.
